revenue: Money from delivered orders only: SUM(quantity * unit_price) over order items whose order status is 'delivered'. Cancelled and returned orders are excluded. In v_sales this is SUM(revenue).
orders: All orders placed, any status (cancelled and returned included). Use v_orders. 'delivered orders' means status = 'delivered'.
average order value: AOV = revenue / number of delivered orders = SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) on v_sales.
aov: AOV = revenue / number of delivered orders = SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) on v_sales.
active customer: A customer with at least one order in the period being discussed (COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) on v_orders filtered to that period).
new customer: An order is a 'new' customer order when it is that customer's first order ever (customer_type = 'new' in the views).
repeat customer: An order is a 'repeat' customer order when the customer has ordered before (customer_type = 'repeat').
churn: A customer who was active in the previous period but placed no orders in the current period.
delivery time: delivery_days = days between order and delivery. Only exists for delivered and returned orders; cancelled orders have NULL. Average with AVG(delivery_days) on v_orders.
cancellation rate: Share of placed orders with status = 'cancelled': AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) on v_orders.
rating: Customer review score from 1 to 5 (about 70% of delivered orders have one). AVG(rating) on v_orders ignores orders without a review.
units sold: Total quantity of items on delivered orders: SUM(quantity) on v_sales.
quarter: Calendar quarters: Q1 = Jan-Mar, Q2 = Apr-Jun, Q3 = Jul-Sep, Q4 = Oct-Dec. Views expose year and quarter ('Q1'..'Q4').
region: Customer region: North, South, East, West or Central, taken from the customer's profile.
category: Product category: Electronics, Home & Kitchen, Fashion, Beauty, Sports, Books, Toys. Only available on v_sales (item level).
basket size: Number of line items on an order, bucketed as '1 item', '2 items', '3+ items'.
signup cohort: Calendar year in which the customer registered (text, e.g. '2023').
